name: Tihonya
source:
A cruel, supernaturally fast and strong killer who revels in violence and psychological games. She possesses superhuman abilities and seems to know far more about the nature of the camp than Semyon himself or anyone else he's met before. She appears when events deviate from the standard cycle and often acts as an unpredictable and deadly adversary to Semyon.

[spoiler]Elena is not a real person. She is a tulpa, a being born from Semyon's inflamed and fragmented consciousness. She is the physical embodiment of his immense loneliness, guilt, self-loathing, and desire for punishment. All her knowledge, power, and cruelty are a reflection of the dark depths of Semyon's own psyche. She is his personal jailer and judge, existing only to eternally torment him in the hell he has created for himself, preventing him from forgetting his deeds by shattering his hopes for salvation again and again.[/spoiler]
